ek.text: Evidence and sources will either support, complement, or contradict a writer’s thesis. CLE-1.AA Writers enhance their credibility when they refute, rebut, or concede opposing arguments and contradictory evidence. CLE-1.AB When writers concede, they accept all or a portion of a competing position or claim as correct, agree that the competing position or claim is correct under a different set of circumstances, or acknowledge the limitations of their own argument. CLE-1.AC When writers rebut, they offer a contrasting perspective on an argument and its evidence or provide alternative evidence to propose that all or a portion of a competing position or claim is invalid.
